description: Defines the ConfigStructure class used for managing configuration data structures, including methods for adding fields, generating C headers, and writing to TunerStudio and Java formats.

classes.name: ConfigStructure
classes.description: Represents a configuration data structure with methods for managing fields, generating code, and handling alignment.

methods.name: addAlignmentFill
methods.description: Adds alignment fill fields to ensure 4-byte alignment based on current total size.

methods.name: headerWrite
methods.description: Generates a C header struct definition for the configuration structure.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Writes configuration fields in TunerStudio format.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Writes configuration fields in Java format.

methods.name: addBoth
methods.description: Adds a ConfigField to both C and TunerStudio field lists.

methods.name: addC
methods.description: Adds a ConfigField to the C fields list.

methods.name: addTs
methods.description: Adds a ConfigField to the TunerStudio fields list.
